name: newspaper
description: An aged front page slides up onto a light board: a masthead line with the date, a big condensed headline, an optional italic subhead, three columns of small type and an optional photo as an engraved oval. Like the "LA JOCONDE A DISPARU" front page in the reference reel. `language` sets the language of the headline (hyphenation and quotes), so a French or Indonesian headline breaks correctly.
useWhen: the speaker quotes a headline, a news report or a front page
an event is introduced as news (a theft, an election, a launch, a disaster)
a date and a headline together anchor a story
